senses.definition: Any of several small warblers, the whitethroat, etc.
(UK, naval slang) The petty officers' mess steward.

quotes.text: Against this, her deck staff runs to about a hundred, being made up of some fifty able-seamen, eight or ten 'peggies' […]
quotes.reference: 1936, Charles Richard Benstead, Atlantic Ferry, page 178:

quotes.text: The number of "peggies" going aft to fetch the meals had been increasing steadily.
